idea: Solve a maximum-weight independent set ILP on a mixed-denominator lattice. Candidate axis-aligned squares have sides i/L and corners on an L×L board with highly composite L (12, 24 or 60), so sizes like 1/3, 1/4 and 3/8 coexist. Non-overlap is enforced by a clique constraint at every interior lattice point, plus an exact count of n.
